name: Public Workshop Site
summary: Static site for Vercel where anyone can read the wiring and flash these projects onto their own Arduino from the browser over WebSerial.
notes: PAUSED - the user decided to keep the Workshop local rather than deploy it. Nothing is deleted; 'vercel --prod' from this folder would still publish it. Uno flashing over WebSerial works (STK500v1 in avr.js); Mega and ESP8266 offer downloads instead.
